sources: data/blueprint/owner-messages.md (60 entries 2026-10-15..2026-10-21; 4 are compaction summaries, not owner words)
context/graph.json requirement + directive.* nodes (68 requirement-typed nodes)
docs/competitive-build-map-v4.md, docs/product-decisions.md, docs/voice-platform-blueprint.md, docs/product-ux-reset-2026-10-01.md and the v6/v7 Relay specs
priority_rule: must = stated as core/non-negotiable or repeated 3+ times; strong = stated clearly once or twice; nice = idea-level, deferred by the owner, or Relay-era and not restated since the 2026-10-15 reset

requirements.requirement: Emotional, relational, exactly-human-sounding voice is THE core product and differentiator.
requirements.quote: the emotional and relational exactly human like sounding agents are the main thing

requirements.requirement: Voice and conversation quality beats margin; never trade the voice for price.
requirements.quote: margin we can basically compremise with but the voice need to be really good

requirements.requirement: Real human conversation, not agenda repetition or robotic behaviour; the caller should feel comfortable.
requirements.quote: capable of doing proper conversations like a human would instead of just repeating the agenda again and again

requirements.requirement: World-class telecalling: open with something interesting and useful, never waste the person's time, read the person and talk more if they want, then ask clearly; the agenda gets done subtly.
requirements.quote: You need to do something interesting and nice and talk about it, and then basically certainly ask, right? Even without wasting the user's time also

requirements.requirement: Expressive voice: emotion, voice modality and reactions; emotional intelligence.
requirements.quote: the feel of emotion and voice modality and reaction etc is not good ... We need more expressive and human like

requirements.requirement: She ends the call herself when it is done.
requirements.quote: when the call is done or she feels like it's done she should be able to cut it from her end

requirements.requirement: Persona register: friendly and human, still professional, interesting and nice to talk to.
requirements.quote: she should be friendly and human like still professional but intresting and nice to talk to

requirements.requirement: A strong brain, better than gpt-oss and better than industry standard; track the newest cheap, fast, strong models.
requirements.quote: i think we need a better brain then gpt oss because the quality we need to be great ... and also do better then the industry standards

requirements.requirement: Hinglish and Hindi expressiveness; learn from Maya; Gemini voices are good in Hinglish.
requirements.quote: gemini voice are good in hinglish. maya voice is good and expressive to specially in hindi

requirements.requirement: Regional language and accent personalisation (a South Indian customer in their language; a Bihar customer in Bihari-Hindi mix).
requirements.quote: calling someone in bihar then it would be better if the voice ai talks in bihari accent and even bihari-hindi mix language which they should relate too

requirements.requirement: Latency has to be good: fast first word, no long waits; faster than competitors.
requirements.quote: the latency also has to be good

requirements.requirement: Relational continuity in long-running and frequent conversations with the same customer.
requirements.quote: our voice have this relational thing, emotional thing, in long running conversations, in frequent conversation with same client

requirements.requirement: The whole application is LLM-native: the client talks to a chat agent instead of navigating a fixed structure.
requirements.quote: They should be coming and talking to a chatbot only to basically do all these things. It should not be basically doing a same structure and figuring it out

requirements.requirement: VP's agents do the work for the client (upload, map, fire, run); the client just talks.
requirements.quote: how everything will be handled for him by our agents and he just have to talk

requirements.requirement: Every part of the product is AI-driven.
requirements.quote: a system that control the whole company and every part of it is driven by AI and the whole thing too

requirements.requirement: The client can also choose the overall product brain (the LLM behind the copilot), not only the call stack.
requirements.quote: give them option to basically select the TTS, the brains, HTT, the overall brain of the whole product also

requirements.requirement: The agent explains and then does it (CSV or any file in, agent fires).
requirements.quote: I have this CSV I want to upload, or I have this file in my some kind of thing and I want to upload and fire this, then he will tell how to do it and he will do it themselves

requirements.requirement: Company command centre: AI CRM, AI ERP, lead generation, scraping, WhatsApp agent, email campaigns, SEO/AEO, all analytics, company brain.
requirements.quote: its the whole company command centre which is intergrated to every part and channel of the company

requirements.requirement: Indian enterprises fire voice agents at their customers, pre-sale (selling, surveys, outreach) and post-sale (feedback, surveys, customer success, predictions).
requirements.quote: Indian enterprises, Indian client basically, which can fire voice agents, voice calling agents to their customers

requirements.requirement: Campaigns handled end to end: launch, analyse, grow.
requirements.quote: how we handle the campaign end to end

requirements.requirement: The whole view of the campaign and of each call.
requirements.quote: give him the whole view of the campign and each call

requirements.requirement: Every call recording is available to the client.
requirements.quote: they can see the voice, every voice call recording

requirements.requirement: A customer-feedback campaign is a complete loop: interview, analysis, team improvement, follow-up.
requirements.quote: (graph requirement.feedback-campaigns, user clarification 2026-09-21; no verbatim)

requirements.requirement: Handle every case around the flow (data, failures, edge cases), better than competitors.
requirements.quote: whole product flow, whole user flow, handling all the cases around it

requirements.requirement: Overview analytics plus extremely deep analysis.
requirements.quote: they can see the overview analytics and extremely depth analysis

requirements.requirement: Amazing AI analysis of each call and of the campaign.
requirements.quote: amazing ai analysis of those

requirements.requirement: Show the client how results improve over time because of learning and personalisation.
requirements.quote: see the how it's changing for them in long running conversations ... how it's recursively self-improving

requirements.requirement: Any type of data the client puts in is taken by the product and turned into something they can fire an agent on.
requirements.quote: any type of the data they put on to a product, and the product takes it and give them an option to fire an agent

requirements.requirement: Omni-channel data connected and managed; VP takes what is useful from it.
requirements.quote: how he will connect onmi channel data how we take usefull from that

requirements.requirement: Company context ingested at onboarding so the agent knows the company.
requirements.quote: it will be better if the voice ai have the context of company too(atleast when we onboard company on vp we take some of the context)

requirements.requirement: Personalise from the customer's other data sources, e.g. what they did in an app.
requirements.quote: other data from various sources lets say what he have done on some app etc

requirements.requirement: Memory and persistence of the voice AI: extract from previous conversations and customer attributes, then personalise the next call.
requirements.quote: we will basically extract so much of data from the previous conversation with the customer and the customer attributes by themselves and do personalization there

requirements.requirement: Learn from the individual and from groups of users.
requirements.quote: since we are learning from the user and group of users there will be so much to learn from in so many ways

requirements.requirement: Self-evolving agents: what is learned by call 100 changes call 101 (e.g. the line where 90 of 100 dropped is rewritten), and improvement is continuous in every way, not one rule.
requirements.quote: lets say in 100 90 were drop of just after some line inbetween the convo so in the 101 call that line should be modified ... it should be on the go self improvement in every way

requirements.requirement: Build self-improvement on google-research/harness2 fundamentals.
requirements.quote: for self improving agents etc when we build them later we will use the fundamentals from this maybe

requirements.requirement: Self-learning and deeper personalisation can be higher-priced tiers; human voice is in the base.
requirements.quote: rest thing like self evolving etc we can loose for now and give it as a higher tier pricing

requirements.requirement: Extremely great product design and usability, amazing UI/UX, animation design, whole product and user flow.
requirements.quote: building the extremely good product with extremely great product design and usability, amazing UI UX, animation design, whole product flow, whole user flow

requirements.requirement: Better than every competitor in every sense: UI, UX, product design, cost, speed, user flow, convenience, usability, vibe, results.
requirements.quote: create a better product then them in every sense (ui,ux, product design, cost, speed, user flow, convinence , usability, vibe and results

requirements.requirement: Self-onboarding in 30 to 60 minutes.
requirements.quote: he can basically onboard themselves in an hour or in a half an hour

requirements.requirement: Deliverables to the owner are visual and fast to review.
requirements.quote: show me that blue print in a visual way so i can see it and review it fast(im a visual learner)

requirements.requirement: Price about Rs 2 per minute or under, while missing nothing.
requirements.quote: the pricing should be less even after doing all this and missing nothing preferably under 2rs per mint

requirements.requirement: Build parts in-house to get cost down, but no self-hosting until there is volume.
requirements.quote: all the things every part i wanna build in house only so that we get the pricing as low as possible / self hosting model im not fan rn until we have enough volume and clients

requirements.requirement: Cheaper and higher quality than competitors.
requirements.quote: we will have a better product than them, a cheaper product than them, a higher quality product than them

requirements.requirement: Charging and pricing are handled clearly inside the product.
requirements.quote: how the charging, pricing will be handled

requirements.requirement: Real-life value, not value on paper.
requirements.quote: really value adding in real life to our clients and not just be value adding on the paper(theory)

requirements.requirement: Meet every client requirement; clients get amazing results and experience.
requirements.quote: full filling every requirement of our clients and they have amazing result and experience with the product

requirements.requirement: Never deny being an AI; disclose once, lightly, and never as an opener that makes people hang up.
requirements.quote: if you just be call and say you are an AI agent and blah blah blah blah and just keep repeating stuff, they will just cut the call

requirements.requirement: No manipulation; crisis lines (Tele-MANAS 14416, 112) stay; synthetic data only in tests.
requirements.quote: (project standing rule, not an owner message)

requirements.requirement: Test integrity: a model never changes mid-call; results are filed under the combination that actually ran; tell the owner when quota runs out.
requirements.quote: we don't want the model to change in between of testing since it might make us do wrong judgment

requirements.requirement: Self-serve platform like Vapi.
requirements.quote: make a serve serve like platform like vapi and all

requirements.requirement: Everything competitors offer (Bolna, Vapi, ElevenLabs), made better: parity is the floor.
requirements.quote: all the rest features what any other player in the market give like bolnaai, vapi, elevenlabs we should have all of them obviously

requirements.requirement: The client picks STT, brain and TTS, with 4-5 curated best combinations and per-use-case selection.
requirements.quote: we can basically give the user also an option to select the stack for the voice AI

requirements.requirement: Default leaning: Gemini TTS for voice and Gemini for ears; final pick after hearing round 2.
requirements.quote: generally I like the Gemini TTS, but rest we will basically choose once we build the whole product

requirements.requirement: Provider-open by measurement (Gemini, Azure/Foundry grant, OpenRouter, Sarvam); Inworld avoided; AWS deferred.
requirements.quote: we can use gemini+azure\foundery(specially whats under the grant) ... inworld lets avoid ... lets avoid aws now

requirements.requirement: Real Indian phone calls; several people can test; friends can enter their own number and get called.
requirements.quote: give a option to select n enter the number so my friends could send out a call on their phone and test

requirements.requirement: Target Indian businesses (likely B2C); exclude big consumer-internet firms with in-house tech teams (Blinkit, Swiggy, Zepto, Zomato).
requirements.quote: we cant target really big tech b2c companies like blinkit,swiggy,zepto,zomato since they will have there own tech team

requirements.requirement: Multiple products around the voice core, like Bolna's CRM layer.
requirements.quote: Bolna AI, they have multiple products, they have CRM also, they have their layer also

requirements.requirement: Frontier technology.
requirements.quote: we need to build frontier product for society we need frontier tech here

requirements.requirement: Understand competitors end to end (product, tech, offerings) to their core.
requirements.quote: crack them to there quantas and we will make something best of everything

requirements.requirement: Keep learning from these companies always, including new launches; voice AI moves daily.
requirements.quote: we need to learn and get the best from all these companies always

requirements.requirement: Store all knowledge so nothing is re-derived and no tokens are wasted.
requirements.quote: Keep saving and storing all the knowledge and tech and data this is so that we don't loose stuff and our efforts and tokes are not waskted

requirements.requirement: Deeper, not bigger: name what a top professional would add, the rawest material, the methods, and the external proof.
requirements.quote: I want a deeper version of this task, not a bigger one

requirements.requirement: Model policy: main chat on the top model at extra-high; elsewhere, the model and effort per use case.
requirements.quote: if mixure of the model and efforts will give better performace at lower tokens then why waste more

requirements.requirement: Work autonomously and in parallel without repeated permission asks.
requirements.quote: I'm giving you the access of everything just behave autonomously

requirements.requirement: Pause, stop, retry and failure states keep operator authority.
requirements.quote: (graph requirement.pause-stop-failure-control-v6, user clarification; no verbatim)

requirements.requirement: Each campaign names its product or service, outcome, audience and evidence basis; identity and columns are reviewed before launch.
requirements.quote: (graph requirement.explicit-offering-outcome-audience-v6 and identity-and-column-review-v6; no verbatim)

requirements.requirement: Company branding and accountable team authentication; bounded web, voice, Telegram and WhatsApp deployment.
requirements.quote: (graph requirement.company-brand-auth-v7 and public-channel-deployment-v7; no verbatim)

requirements.requirement: Review-first AI UX that shows uncertainty, provenance and control (in tension with just-talk; keep it as visible review, not friction).
requirements.quote: (graph requirement.thoughtful-ai-ux-v7; no verbatim)
